name: AI Boy
tagline: Start and supervise Claude Code or Codex coding runs from inside Grok
description: If you already pay for Claude Code or Codex, this lets you drive those coding sessions from a Grok conversation instead of living in a terminal. Kick off a task, watch it progress and wrap it up once it is done, all from one place. It is a convenience layer over tools you already have, not a substitute for them.
author: infdaze
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
